mapper.select: select now()
select 1 from (select pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(#{value}, 0))) as advisory_lock
select from pep_metering.quota_account where scope_kind = #{scopeKind} and subject_id = #{subjectId} order by scope_kind, subject_id, id for update
select from pep_metering.quota_account where scope_kind = #{scopeKind} and subject_id = #{subjectId} order by policy_key
select from pep_metering.quota_account where id = #{id} for update
select id, account_id, policy_revision, generation, start_at, end_at, activation_state, limit_units, used_units, held_units from pep_metering.quota_bucket where id = #{id}
select id, account_id, policy_revision, generation, start_at, end_at, activation_state, limit_units, used_units, held_units from pep_metering.quota_bucket where id = #{id} for update
select coalesce(max(generation), -1) + 1 from pep_metering.quota_bucket where account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: insert into pep_metering.quota_bucket (id, account_id, policy_revision, generation, start_at, end_at, activation_state, limit_units, used_units, held_units) values (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{policyRevision}, #{generation}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{activationState}, #{limitUnits}, 0, 0)
mapper.update: update pep_metering.quota_bucket set activation_state = #{state} where id = #{bucketId}
update pep_metering.quota_bucket set held_units = held_units + #{delta} where id = #{bucketId}
update pep_metering.quota_bucket set used_units = used_units + #{settledUnits} where id = #{bucketId}
mapper.select: select id, model_call_id, reserved_units, state from pep_metering.quota_reservation where id = #{id} for update
select id, reservation_id, account_id, bucket_id, reserved_units, settled_units, state from pep_metering.reservation_charge where reservation_id = #{reservationId} order by account_id for update
mapper.insert: insert into pep_metering.model_call (id, logical_call_id, attempt_no, billing_subject_id, scope_kind, actor_id, tenant_id, project_id, task_id, run_id, model_profile_key, provider, model, request_hash, state) values (#{id}, #{logicalCallId}, #{attemptNo}, #{billingSubjectId}, #{scopeKind}, #{actorId}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{taskId}, #{runId}, #{modelProfileKey}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{requestHash}, #{state})
insert into pep_metering.quota_reservation (id, model_call_id, reserved_units, state, dispatch_deadline, version) values (#{id}, #{modelCallId}, #{units}, 'HELD', #{dispatchDeadline}, 0)
insert into pep_metering.reservation_charge (id, reservation_id, account_id, bucket_id, reserved_units, state) values (#{id}, #{reservationId}, #{accountId}, #{bucketId}, #{units}, 'HELD')
mapper.update: update pep_metering.quota_reservation set state = 'DISPATCHED', dispatched_at = now(), version = version + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and state = 'HELD' and dispatch_deadline >= now()
update pep_metering.model_call set state = #{state}, provider_request_id = coalesce(#{providerRequestId}, provider_request_id), updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update pep_metering.model_call set state = 'DISPATCHED', dispatched_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into pep_metering.quota_ledger_entry (id, account_id, bucket_id, reservation_id, event_type, delta_used, delta_held, source_event_id) values (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{bucketId}, #{reservationId}, #{eventType}, #{deltaUsed}, #{deltaHeld}, #{sourceEventId}) on conflict (account_id, source_event_id) do nothing

insert into pep_metering.model_usage (id, model_call_id, normalization_version, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, reasoning_tokens, quota_units, quality, provider_usage_hash, raw_usage) values (#{id}, #{modelCallId}, 'v1', #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{cacheReadTokens}, #{cacheWriteTokens}, #{reasoningTokens}, #{quotaUnits}, #{quality}, #{providerUsageHash}, cast(#{rawUsage} as jsonb)) on conflict (model_call_id) do nothing
mapper.select: select id, model_call_id, reserved_units, state from pep_metering.quota_reservation where state = 'HELD' and dispatch_deadline < now() order by dispatch_deadline limit #{limit} for update skip locked

select count(*) from pep_metering.quota_reservation r join pep_metering.model_call c on c.id = r.model_call_id where c.scope_kind = #{scopeKind} and c.billing_subject_id = #{subjectId} and r.state = 'UNCERTAIN'

select c.id, c.reservation_id, c.account_id, c.bucket_id, c.reserved_units, c.settled_units, c.state from pep_metering.reservation_charge c join pep_metering.quota_reservation r on r.id = c.reservation_id where r.model_call_id = #{modelCallId} order by c.account_id
mapper.insert: insert into pep_metering.quota_policy_version (id, policy_key, revision, mode, limit_units, duration_seconds, effective_at, expires_at) values (#{id}, #{policyKey}, #{revision}, #{mode}, #{limitUnits}, #{durationSeconds}, #{effectiveAt}, #{expiresAt})

insert into pep_metering.quota_account (id, scope_kind, subject_id, policy_key, active_revision, state, debt_units, version) values (#{id}, #{scopeKind}, #{subjectId}, #{policyKey}, #{revision}, 'ACTIVE', 0, 0) on conflict (scope_kind, subject_id, policy_key) do nothing

insert into pep_metering.quota_change_request (id, account_id, old_revision, new_revision, action, effective_mode, reason, actor_id, idempotency_key) values (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{oldRevision}, #{newRevision}, #{action}, #{effectiveMode}, #{reason}, #{actorId}, #{idempotencyKey})

insert into pep_metering.usage_adjustment (id, model_call_id, adjustment_no, delta_units, reason, evidence_ref, operator_id, idempotency_key) values (#{id}, #{modelCallId}, #{adjustmentNo}, #{deltaUnits}, #{reason}, #{evidenceRef}, #{operatorId}, #{idempotencyKey})
